name: The Final Judgement
source:
Our protagonist thought he would have a quiet life at university, but fate has given him the opportunity to awaken supernatural powers to save his world from an imminent threat.

Will he use his powers for the good of humanity or will he take advantage of it for...?​

[From F95 Zone]
translation:
我们的主角本以为他会在大学过平静的生活，但命运给了他觉醒超自然力量的机会，以拯救他的世界免受迫在眉睫的威胁。

他会利用自己的力量造福人类，还是会利用它……？​

[来自F95区]
